words.ex: Sandra is my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 桑德拉是我最好的朋友。
words.en: sandra

words.tr:
n. 舵手；艇长
v. 做舵手
words.ex: He coxed the boat to victory.
words.ex_cn: 他掌舵船只赢得了胜利。
words.en: The cox is the person who steers a boat, especially in a race.

words.ex: He likes to study physics in school.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在学校学习物理。
words.en: Physics is the scientific study of matter, energy, force, and motion, and how they relate to each other.

words.ex: He bought a recent book about history.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一本最近出版的历史书。
words.en: Having happened, begun, or been done not long ago or not long before; belonging to a past period comparatively close to the present.

words.ex: He will perform the task tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会执行这个任务。
words.en: To perform means to carry out, accomplish, or fulfill an action, task, or function. It can also refer to the act of presenting a form of entertainment, such as a play, concert, or other artistic expression, before an audience.

words.ex: I advise you to eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 我建议你多吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you advise someone to do something, you tell them what you think they should do.

words.ex: I agree with you.
words.ex_cn: 我同意你的看法。
words.en: If people agree with each other about something, they have the same opinion about it or say that they have the same opinion.

words.tr:
n. 胶；胶水；
v. 粘合；
words.ex: He used glue to stick the paper together.
words.ex_cn: 他用胶把纸粘在一起。
words.en: A sticky substance used for joining things together.

words.ex: He left the room immediately after the bell rang.
words.ex_cn: 铃声一响，他就立即离开了房间。
words.en: If something happens immediately, it happens without any delay.

words.ex: I am glad to see you.
words.ex_cn: 我很高兴见到你。
words.en: If you are glad about something, you are happy and pleased about it.

words.ex: He finished the work ahead of time.
words.ex_cn: 他提前完成了工作。
words.en: If someone is ahead in a competition or comparison, they are winning or doing better than the other people involved.

words.ex: He ate a pancake for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一块煎饼。
words.en: A pancake is a thin, flat, round cake prepared from a batter and cooked on a hot griddle or frying pan.

words.ex: She squeezed a lemon into her water.
words.ex_cn: 她把一个柠檬挤进水里。
words.en: A lemon is a bright yellow fruit with very sour juice. Lemons grow on trees in warm countries.

words.tr: n. 比萨饼；披萨；意大利薄饼；
words.ex: I ate a pizza for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚餐吃了一块比萨饼。
words.en: A pizza is a flat, round piece of dough baked with tomato, cheese, and sometimes other ingredients on top.

words.ex: I hate waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 我讨厌早起。
words.en: To hate someone or something means to feel intense or passionate dislike for them.

words.tr:
conj. 两者之一；
adv. 也（用于否定词组后）；
pron. 两者中的任何一个；（用于否定句）两者都不；
words.ex: You can have either tea or coffee.
words.ex_cn: 你可以喝茶或者咖啡，二选一。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified (the other being introduced by ‘or’).

words.tr:
n. 梳子
v. 梳理；搜寻
words.ex: He uses a comb to tidy his hair.
words.ex_cn: 他用梳子整理头发。
words.en: A comb is a flat piece of plastic or metal with narrow pointed teeth along one side, which you use to make your hair neat.

words.ex: Patrick was a kind and gentle man.
words.ex_cn: 帕特里克是一个善良温和的人。
words.en: patrick

words.tr:
n. 补助金；授予物；
v. 承认；授予；允许；
words.ex: The university received a grant for scientific research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学收到了一笔用于科学研究的补助金。
words.en: If someone in authority grants you something, or if something is granted to you, you are allowed to have it or do it.

words.ex: He eats a pea from his plate.
words.ex_cn: 他从盘子里吃了一颗豌豆。
words.en: A pea is a small, round, green seed which is eaten as a vegetable and which is formed in a pod on a climbing plant.

words.ex: The pea grows inside a green pod.
words.ex_cn: 豌豆长在绿色的荚里。
words.en: A pod is a case that holds the seeds of certain plants, such as peas and beans.

words.tr:
n. 副本；(书，报纸等的) 一本；复制品；
v. 复制；
words.ex: Please give me a copy of the report.
words.ex_cn: 请给我一份报告的副本。
words.en: A copy is a thing made to be similar or identical to another. As a verb, to copy means to make a similar or identical version of something.

words.tr:
n. 惊讶；意外；惊喜；
v. 使惊奇；使感到意外；
words.ex: She felt a surprise when she saw the gift.
words.ex_cn: 当她看到礼物时，感到很惊讶。
words.en: If something surprises you, it happens unexpectedly and causes you to feel surprise.

words.ex: He shouted angrily at the driver.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地对司机大喊。
words.en: In a manner that shows anger or strong resentment.

words.ex: Can you lend me your pen?
words.ex_cn: 你能把你的笔借给我吗？
words.en: If you lend something you own to someone else, you allow them to have it or use it for a period of time, after which they must return it to you.

words.ex: He cheated on the test by copying answers.
words.ex_cn: 他通过抄答案来作弊。
words.en: To cheat means to act dishonestly or unfairly in order to gain an advantage, especially in a game or examination.

words.tr: adj. 接着的；下列的； prep. 在...之后； v. 跟随；“follow”的现在分词； n. 下列各项；
words.ex: The following day, we went to the park.
words.ex_cn: 接着的那天，我们去了公园。
words.en: Coming after or as a result of something; a group of supporters or admirers.

words.ex: He goes to the gym every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上去健身房。
words.en: A gym is a place equipped for physical exercise and training, especially for athletes or for people who want to keep fit.

words.tr: adj. 尴尬的；窘迫的； v. “embarrass”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt embarrassed when he tripped in front of everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他在大家面前绊倒时感到很尴尬。
words.en: If you are embarrassed, you feel shy or ashamed because of something that you have done or that has happened to you.

words.ex: The soldier fought against his enemy in the war.
words.ex_cn: 士兵在战争中与他的敌人作战。
words.en: An enemy is someone who opposes you, competes with you, or is hostile towards you.

words.tr:
v. 处理；对付；交易；
n. 交易；协议；
words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems easily.
words.ex_cn: 他能轻松处理困难的问题。
words.en: A deal is an agreement or arrangement, especially in business or politics, that is beneficial to all the parties involved.

words.ex: Someone left their bag on the chair.
words.ex_cn: 有人把包落在椅子上了。
words.en: You use someone to refer to a person without saying exactly who you mean.

words.ex: He was born in England.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在英格兰。
words.en: England is a country that is part of the United Kingdom. It shares land borders with Scotland to the north and Wales to the west; the Irish Sea is to the north west, the Celtic Sea to the south west, while the North Sea to the east and the English Channel to the south separate it from continental Europe.

words.ex: He is knowledgeable about history and science.
words.ex_cn: 他对历史和科学都很博学。
words.en: Someone who is knowledgeable has or shows a clear understanding of many different facts about the world or about a particular subject.

words.ex: My teacher encourages me to speak English every day.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师鼓励我每天说英语。
words.en: If you encourage someone, you give them confidence, for example by letting them know that what they are doing is good and telling them that they should continue to do it.

words.ex: We will discuss the homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天讨论作业。
words.en: To discuss something means to talk about it with someone and tell each other your ideas or opinions.

words.tr:
n. 病人；
adj. 有耐心的；
words.ex: The doctor helped the patient feel better.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助病人感觉好些了。
words.en: A patient person is able to wait for a long time or deal with a difficult situation without becoming angry or upset.

words.ex: He plays the piano every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上弹钢琴。
words.en: A piano is a large musical instrument with a keyboard. When you press the keys, small hammers hit strings inside the piano, which produce musical notes.

words.ex: He wears blue jeans every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿蓝色牛仔裤。
words.en: Jeans are casual trousers made from denim or dungaree cloth.

words.ex: Reading gives me great pleasure.
words.ex_cn: 阅读带给我极大的快乐。
words.en: Pleasure is a feeling of happiness, satisfaction, or enjoyment.

words.ex: He bought fresh vegetables from the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他从本地市场买了新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: Something that is local relates to a particular area or to the area where you live.

words.ex: He loves geography and learns about countries and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢地理学，学习各国和河流的知识。
words.en: The study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.ex: I will call you sometime next week.
words.ex_cn: 我下周某个时候给你打电话。
words.en: At some unspecified or unknown time.

words.ex: The painter draws a beautiful house.
words.ex_cn: 这位画家画了一座美丽的房子。
words.en: A painter is someone who paints pictures, or someone whose job is to paint surfaces such as walls and doors.

words.tr: n. 时间表；时刻表；课程表；
words.ex: The school publishes a new timetable every term.
words.ex_cn: 学校每学期都会公布新的时间表。
words.en: A timetable is a detailed plan showing the times at which things are intended to happen, especially the times at which particular events or activities are planned to occur.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.ex: The runner won the race quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这位跑步者很快赢得了比赛。
words.en: A runner is a person who runs, especially in a race or as a sport.

words.tr:
prep. 除了；
conj. 只是；
words.ex: Everyone went to the party except Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，大家都去参加派对了。
words.en: You use except to introduce the only thing or person that a statement does not apply to, or a fact that prevents a statement from being completely true.

words.tr:
adv. 在今晚；
n. 今晚；
words.ex: We will have dinner together tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我们今晚一起吃晚饭。
words.en: Tonight refers to the evening or night of the current day.

words.tr:
prep. 自…以后；从…以来；
conj. 因为；由于；既然；从…以后；
adv. 此后；后来；
words.ex: He has lived here since 2020.
words.ex_cn: 他自2020年以来一直住在这里。
words.en: From a past time until now; because; as a result of the fact that.

words.tr: adj. 拙劣的；贫穷的；缺少的；可怜的；
words.ex: The acting in that movie was poor.
words.ex_cn: 那部电影的表演很拙劣。
words.en: If you describe someone as poor, you mean that they do not have enough money to live on or that they have very little money.

words.tr:
n. 咳嗽；
v. 咳嗽；
words.ex: He had a bad cough last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚咳得很厉害。
words.en: A cough is a sudden, forceful expulsion of air from the lungs, often caused by irritation in the airway.

words.ex: He was late because the bus was slow.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车很慢。
words.en: You use 'because' when stating the reason for something.

words.ex: He seems tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后似乎很累。
words.en: If something seems to be a particular way, it appears to be that way.

words.ex: This store is convenient for buying groceries.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店买杂货很方便。
words.en: If something is convenient, it is easy to use or do, or it is useful and suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: Lisa is reading a book.
words.ex_cn: 丽莎正在读书。
words.en: A female given name, often a short form of Elizabeth or Melissa.

words.ex: I paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天付了电费账单。
words.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or services, a proposed law presented to a legislature for approval, a piece of paper money, or the beak of a bird.

words.ex: I download music from the internet.
words.ex_cn: 我从互联网下载音乐。
words.en: To download data means to transfer it to your computer or device from another computer or from the internet.

words.ex: The librarian helps students find books.
words.ex_cn: 图书管理员帮助学生找书。
words.en: A librarian is a person who is in charge of a library or who has been trained to do this work.

words.ex: Suddenly, the light went out.
words.ex_cn: 突然，灯灭了。
words.en: If something happens suddenly, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

words.tr:
n. 冲；匆忙；
v. 冲；赶忙做；
words.ex: There was a rush to buy tickets for the concert.
words.ex_cn: 人们争相购买演唱会的票。
words.en: If you rush somewhere, you go there quickly. A rush is a situation in which you need to go somewhere or do something very quickly.

words.ex: The cat jumped into the box.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳进了盒子里。
words.en: If you go into a place or thing, you move from the outside to the inside of it.

words.ex: He shouted for help when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时大叫着求救。
words.en: If you shout, you say something very loudly, usually because you want people a long distance away to hear you or because you are angry.

words.tr:
v. 耳语；低语
n. 耳语；低语；沙沙的声音
words.ex: He whispered a secret to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友低语了一个秘密。
words.en: To speak very quietly using one's breath rather than one's throat, especially for the sake of privacy.

words.tr: n. 四分之一；季度；一刻钟；地区；方向；
words.ex: He ate a quarter of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了四分之一的比萨。
words.en: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something, or a period of three months.

words.ex: I recently bought a new book.
words.ex_cn: 我最近买了一本新书。
words.en: If something happened recently, it happened only a short time ago.

words.ex: He lives in the southern part of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在城市的南部。
words.en: Located in or characteristic of a region in the south.

words.ex: The tourist took photos at the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅游者在博物馆拍照。
words.en: A tourist is a person who is visiting a place for pleasure and interest, especially when they are on holiday.

words.tr:
pron. 我的（东西）；
n. 矿；
v. 采矿；
words.ex: This book is mine.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是我的。
words.en: Used to refer to a thing or things belonging to or associated with the speaker. A place where minerals are extracted from the earth. To extract minerals from the earth.

words.ex: The ocean is very big and deep.
words.ex_cn: 海洋非常大且深。
words.en: The vast body of salt water that covers almost three quarters of the earth's surface.

words.ex: Please remind me to call my mom tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 请提醒我明天给我妈妈打电话。
words.en: If someone reminds you of a fact or event that you already know about, they say something which makes you think about it.

words.ex: He finally finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他终于完成了作业。
words.en: You use finally to suggest that something happens after a long period of time, usually later than you wanted or expected.

words.ex: We had a discussion about homework.
words.ex_cn: 我们进行了一次关于作业的讨论。
words.en: A discussion is a conversation or debate about a specific topic.

words.ex: We celebrate my birthday with cake and friends.
words.ex_cn: 我们用蛋糕和朋友庆祝我的生日。
words.en: To celebrate means to mark a special day, event, or occasion with festivities or ceremonies. It can also mean to praise or honor someone or something.

words.ex: He sat in the mid row of the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在教室的中间一排。
words.en: Mid is used to describe something that is in the middle of a range or series.

words.ex: The lunar surface is covered with dust.
words.ex_cn: 月球表面覆盖着尘土。
words.en: Of or relating to the moon.

words.tr:
prep. 在…周围；环绕；
adv. 环绕；附近；
adj. 圆的；十足的；
n. 回合；圆形物；
v. 拐过；使成圆形；
words.ex: The children sat round the fire.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们围坐在火堆旁。
words.en: Something that is round is shaped like a circle or a ball.

words.ex: The party was a celebration of her graduation.
words.ex_cn: 这个派对是她毕业的庆祝。
words.en: A celebration is a special enjoyable event that people organize because something pleasant has happened or because it is someone's birthday or anniversary.

words.tr: adv. 然而；不过；不论到什么程度；无论如何；
words.ex: I like coffee; however, I drink tea in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡；然而，我早上喝茶。
words.en: You use however when you are adding a comment which is surprising or which contrasts with what has just been said.

words.ex: We eat turkey on Thanksgiving.
words.ex_cn: 我们在感恩节吃火鸡。
words.en: Thanksgiving is a national holiday celebrated primarily in the United States and Canada as a day of giving thanks for the blessing of the harvest and of the preceding year.

words.tr:
v. 想知道；
n. 惊奇；奇迹；
words.ex: I wonder why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想知道他为什么迟到了。
words.en: To feel curiosity or doubt about something; a feeling of surprise mingled with admiration, caused by something beautiful, unexpected, unfamiliar, or inexplicable.

words.ex: His memory is very good; he remembers everything.
words.ex_cn: 他的记忆力很好；他什么都记得。
words.en: Memory is the faculty by which the mind stores and remembers information.

words.tr:
n. 过去；昔日；
adj. 过去的；昔日的；
prep. 超过；晚于；
adv. 经过；
words.ex: He never talks about the past.
words.ex_cn: 他从不谈论过去。
words.en: The past is the time before the present, and the things that have happened.

words.ex: He flipped through the album with old photos.
words.ex_cn: 他翻看着装满旧照片的相册。
words.en: An album is a collection of several pieces of music, songs, or photographs that are intended to form a single item.

words.ex: He chooses coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都选择喝咖啡。
words.en: To choose means to select someone or something from a group of possibilities.

words.ex: His collection of old coins is very rare.
words.ex_cn: 他收集的旧硬币非常稀有。
words.en: A collection is a group of things, often of the same type, that have been gathered together over a period of time.

words.tr:
n. 幻灯片；滑梯；
v. （使）滑动；下滑；
words.ex: He showed a slide of his vacation photos.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了一张他度假照片的幻灯片。
words.en: To move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it; to pass or move quietly or smoothly; a structure with a smooth sloping surface for children to slide down; a decline from a higher to a lower level or status.

words.tr:
n. 记录；唱片；
v. 记录；录制；
words.ex: The school keeps a record of all student grades.
words.ex_cn: 学校保存所有学生成绩的记录。
words.en: A record is a piece of information or an account of something that is written down or stored on a computer or other device so that it can be referred to later.

words.tr:
n. 见解；风景；视野；
v. 观看；审视；
words.ex: His view on education is very different from mine.
words.ex_cn: 他对教育的见解与我的非常不同。
words.en: Your view of a particular subject is the way that you understand and think about it.

words.tr: adj. 充满生机的；活泼的；
words.ex: The market is lively with people and music.
words.ex_cn: 市场里人来人往，音乐欢快，充满生机。
words.en: If you describe someone as lively, you mean they are full of life, energy, or enthusiasm.

words.ex: His birth was in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: The emergence of a baby or other young from the body of its mother; the start of life as a physically separate being.

words.tr: v. 出席；参加；注意；照料；
words.ex: He will attend the meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会出席会议。
words.en: To be present at an event, meeting, or function; to take care of or look after someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 触摸；触觉；触感；
v. 触摸；接触；触动；
words.ex: The touch of her hand was gentle.
words.ex_cn: 她手的触摸很温柔。
words.en: If you touch something, you feel it with your hand, or come into physical contact with it.

words.ex: The size of the box is too big for the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的大小对架子来说太大了。
words.en: The physical dimensions, proportions, magnitude, or extent of an object.

words.tr:
v. 符合；合身；
adj. 健康的；适合的；
words.ex: This shirt fits me well.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫很合我的身。
words.en: If something fits, it is the right size and shape to go onto a person's body or onto a particular object.

words.tr: adv. 不管怎样；无论如何；
words.ex: I don't like the weather, but anyway, we will go for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这天气，但不管怎样，我们会去散步。
words.en: You use anyway or anyhow to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous point.

words.tr: n. 风格；方式；样式；文体；
words.ex: Her dress has a unique style.
words.ex_cn: 她的裙子有一种独特的风格。
words.en: A particular kind, sort, or type, as with reference to form, appearance, or character.

words.tr:
v. 拥抱；紧抱；抱有；挨着
n. 拥抱；搂抱
words.ex: She gave him a big hug when he arrived.
words.ex_cn: 他到达时，她给了他一个大大的拥抱。
words.en: To hug someone means to put your arms around them and hold them tightly, for example because you like them or are pleased to see them.

words.ex: We ate turkey for Thanksgiving dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我们在感恩节晚餐上吃了火鸡。
words.en: A turkey is a large bird that is often eaten at Christmas or Thanksgiving.

words.ex: We had a quick meal at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃了一顿简单的饭。
words.en: A meal is an occasion when people sit down to eat food, especially breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

words.tr: n. 收集；采集；聚会；聚集； v. 聚集；集合；“gather”的现在分词；
words.ex: The gathering of old books took him years.
words.ex_cn: 收集旧书花了他多年时间。
words.en: A gathering is a group of people meeting together for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He ate ice cream for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃冰淇淋当甜食。
words.en: Dessert is a sweet course eaten at the end of a meal.

words.ex: We had a short conversation about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们简短地聊了聊天气。
words.en: A conversation is a talk between two or more people, in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.ex: He finished in the thirteenth position.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了第十三名。
words.en: The ordinal number corresponding to the cardinal number thirteen.

words.tr: n. 磁带；录音带；胶带；带子；
words.ex: He recorded the song on a tape.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首歌录在磁带上。
words.en: A tape is a narrow strip of plastic or other material that is used for recording sound or pictures, or for sticking things together.

words.tr:
n. 邮件；职位；邮寄；帖子；柱；
v. 邮寄；张贴；
words.ex: I checked the post this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上检查了邮件。
words.en: To post something means to send it through the postal system or to display it publicly, such as on a noticeboard or the internet. It can also refer to the act of assigning someone to a particular job or position.

words.tr:
adv. 还；然而；
conj. 然而；
words.ex: He hasn't finished his homework yet.
words.ex_cn: 他还没有完成作业。
words.en: You use yet in negative statements to indicate that something has not happened up to the present time, although it probably will happen.

words.tr:
n. 地址；演讲；
v. 解决；向…讲话；
words.ex: Please write your address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的地址写在表格上。
words.en: The particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated; a formal speech delivered to an audience.

words.tr:
n. 顶；顶部；顶端；
adj. 最高的；极棒的；
v. 胜过；超过；
words.ex: The top of the mountain is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 山顶上覆盖着雪。
words.en: The highest or uppermost point, part, or surface of something.

words.ex: He put a stamp on the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他在信封上贴了一张邮票。
words.en: A stamp is a small piece of paper which you stick on an envelope or package before you post it to pay for the cost of the postage. It can also mean to bring down your foot heavily on the ground or to impress a pattern or mark on a surface.

words.ex: The postman delivers letters every morning.
words.ex_cn: 邮递员每天早上送信。
words.en: A postman is a person whose job is to collect and deliver letters and parcels that are sent by post.

words.ex: She loves to follow the latest fashion.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢追随最新的时尚。
words.en: Fashion is a popular style of clothes, hair, etc. at a particular time.

words.tr: n. 气球；热气球；玩具气球；球状物；
words.ex: The child held a red balloon at the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在派对上拿着一个红色的气球。
words.en: A balloon is a small, thin, rubber bag that you blow air into so that it becomes larger and rounder or longer. Balloons are used as toys or decorations.

words.ex: He lit a candle to see in the dark.
words.ex_cn: 他点燃了一支蜡烛以便在黑暗中看见。
words.en: A candle is a stick of wax with a wick through the middle which is lit to give light as it burns.

words.tr:
adj. 深的；
adv. 深深地；
n. 深处；
words.ex: The well is deep.
words.ex_cn: 这口井很深。
words.en: Extending far down from the top or surface; of great vertical extent.

words.ex: He took a deep breath before jumping.
words.ex_cn: 他跳之前深吸了一口气。
words.en: The air taken into or expelled from the lungs.

words.tr:
v. 吹；打击；
n. 打击；
words.ex: The wind blows the leaves away.
words.ex_cn: 风吹走了树叶。
words.en: To move air or gas forcefully; to strike something with force.

words.tr: n. 街坊；四邻；附近地区；
words.ex: We know all our neighbours in this neighbourhood.
words.ex_cn: 我们认识这个街坊里的所有邻居。
words.en: A neighbourhood is one of the parts of a town where people live.

words.ex: The recipe is perfect for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱对初学者来说是完备的。
words.en: Something that is perfect is as good as it could possibly be.

words.ex: He is thirsty after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后口渴了。
words.en: If you are thirsty, you feel a need to drink something.

words.tr:
adj. 完整的；完成的；
v. 完成；
words.ex: The book is complete with all chapters.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有所有章节，是完整的。
words.en: If you complete something, you finish doing, making, or producing it.

words.ex: I bought fresh bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 我从面包房买了新鲜面包。
words.en: A bakery is a place where bread, cakes, and pastries are made or sold.

words.ex: He ate a biscuit with tea.
words.ex_cn: 他喝茶时吃了一块饼干。
words.en: A biscuit is a small, flat cake that is crisp and usually sweet.

words.tr:
n. 市中心区；商业区；
adv. 在市区；往市区；
words.ex: We went downtown to buy some clothes.
words.ex_cn: 我们去市中心买了一些衣服。
words.en: Downtown refers to the central part or main business and commercial area of a city or town.

words.ex: He drinks coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝咖啡。
words.en: Coffee is a hot drink made from the roasted and ground seeds of a tropical shrub.

words.tr:
prep. 通过；穿过；
adv. 从头到尾地；彻底；
adj. 直通的；
words.ex: He walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过了门。
words.en: Moving in one side and out of the other side of (an opening, channel, or location).

words.ex: He ate a cherry from the bowl.
words.ex_cn: 他从碗里吃了一颗樱桃。
words.en: A cherry is a small, round fruit that is typically bright or dark red. It is often eaten fresh or used in cooking and baking.

words.ex: He walks on the sidewalk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都在人行道上走路。
words.en: A sidewalk is a path with a hard surface by the side of a road that people walk on.

words.ex: He cleaned the room himself.
words.ex_cn: 他亲自打扫了房间。
words.en: used as the object of a verb or preposition when the male subject of the verb is also the object

words.ex: The entrance to the building is on the left.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的入口在左边。
words.en: An entrance is a way into a place, such as a door or gate. It can also refer to the act of entering a place or the right to enter.

words.ex: Michael likes to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 迈克尔喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: Michael is a male given name, derived from the Hebrew name מִיכָאֵל (Mikha'el), meaning 'Who is like God?'.

words.ex: Ducks swim in the pond.
words.ex_cn: 鸭子在池塘里游泳。
words.en: A pond is a small area of water that is smaller than a lake, often artificially created.

words.tr:
v. （使）结冰；（使）冻结；
n. 严寒期；冻结；
words.ex: The water will freeze in cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 水在寒冷的天气里会结冰。
words.en: If a liquid or a substance containing a liquid freezes, or if something freezes it, it becomes solid because of low temperatures.

words.ex: He plays hockey every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末打冰球。
words.en: Hockey is a sport played on ice or on a field, in which two teams try to hit a small hard object called a puck or a ball into the other team's goal using long curved sticks.

words.tr:
n. 大楼；大厦；块；街区；障碍物；
v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: The new block is next to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这栋新大楼就在公园旁边。
words.en: A block is a large solid piece of material with flat surfaces on each side. As a verb, to block means to prevent movement or progress.

words.ex: I deposited money at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 我到银行存了钱。
words.en: A bank is an institution where people or businesses can keep their money or borrow money. It can also refer to the land alongside a river or lake.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；整体的；
n. 整个；全部；
words.ex: He ate the whole cake by himself.
words.ex_cn: 他一个人吃掉了整个蛋糕。
words.en: The whole of something is all of it.

words.tr:
v. 聊天；
n. 聊天；
words.ex: They chat every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后聊天。
words.en: To talk in a friendly and informal way.

words.tr:
n. 费用；代价；
v. 花费；
words.ex: The cost of the book is ten dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的费用是十美元。
words.en: The amount of money that you need in order to buy, make, or do something.

words.tr:
n. 面试；访谈；
v. 面试；接见；
words.ex: He has an interview tomorrow for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一场新工作的面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

words.ex: The tailor made a new suit for the man.
words.ex_cn: 裁缝为这位男士做了一套新西装。
words.en: A tailor is a person whose job is to make men's clothes, especially suits, jackets, and trousers, that fit individual customers. As a verb, to tailor means to make or adapt something for a particular purpose or person.

words.ex: He will fix the broken chair tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会修理那把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: To fix something means to repair it, to make it firm or stable, or to arrange or decide it.

words.tr:
n. 声音；声响；
v. 听起来；
adj. 健全的；合理的；可靠的；
words.ex: I heard a strange sound at night.
words.ex_cn: 我半夜听到了一个奇怪的声音。
words.en: Sound is a vibration that propagates as an acoustic wave, through a transmission medium such as a gas, liquid or solid. In human physiology and psychology, sound is the reception of such waves and their perception by the brain.

words.ex: The picnic was an enjoyable day with friends.
words.ex_cn: 野餐是和朋友一起度过的愉快一天。
words.en: Something that is enjoyable gives you pleasure.

words.tr:
v. 治疗；对待；
n. 款待；
words.ex: The doctor will treat his fever with medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生会用药物治疗他的发烧。
words.en: If you treat someone or something in a particular way, you behave towards them or deal with them in that way.

words.ex: He stayed home because he had the flu.
words.ex_cn: 他因为得了流感待在家里。
words.en: The flu is an infectious disease characterized by fever, aches and pains, and respiratory symptoms.

words.ex: He walks one mile to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天步行一英里去学校。
words.en: A unit of linear measure equal to 1,760 yards (approximately 1.609 kilometers).

words.tr:
prep. 穿过；横过；在…对面；
adv. 横过；穿过；越过；
words.ex: He walked across the street.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过街道。
words.en: From one side to the other of something with clear limits, such as an area of land, a road, or a river.

words.tr: v. 可能；也许；“may”的过去式； n. 强大力量；
words.ex: He might come to the party tonight.
words.ex_cn: 他今晚可能会来参加派对。
words.en: Might is used to indicate that something is possible or might happen, or to ask for permission in a polite way.

words.ex: The scientist studies stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家研究夜空中的恒星。
words.en: A scientist is someone who has studied science and whose job is to teach or do research in science.

words.tr: v. 生长；成长；渐渐变成；种植；
words.ex: The plant grows quickly in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物在春天长得很快。
words.en: If someone or something grows, they increase in size, amount, or degree, often over a period of time.

words.ex: He is an engineer who builds bridges.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名建造桥梁的工程师。
words.en: An engineer is a person who designs, builds, or maintains engines, machines, or public works.

words.ex: The newspaper has ten pages.
words.ex_cn: 这份报纸有十版。
words.en: A page is one side of a sheet of paper in a book, magazine, newspaper, or other collection of bound sheets.

words.ex: He signed his name in the yearbook.
words.ex_cn: 他在年鉴上签了自己的名字。
words.en: A yearbook is a book published annually by a school, college, or university, recording the events and achievements of the previous year and often containing photographs of students and faculty.

words.ex: He sees an airplane in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 他看到天上有一架飞机。
words.en: An airplane is a vehicle with wings and one or more engines that enable it to fly through the air.

words.ex: The pilot landed the plane safely.
words.ex_cn: 飞行员安全地降落了飞机。
words.en: A pilot is a person who operates the flying controls of an aircraft. Also, to pilot something means to test or introduce a new idea, product, etc., to see if it will be successful.

words.tr:
n. 害怕；惧怕；
v. 害怕；惧怕；
words.ex: He felt a deep fear when he saw the snake.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到蛇时，感到深深的害怕。
words.en: An unpleasant emotion caused by the threat of danger, pain, or harm.

words.ex: The height of the tree is ten meters.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树的高度是十米。
words.en: The measurement of someone or something from head to foot or from base to top.

words.ex: He overcame his fear of speaking in public.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了当众演讲的恐惧。
words.en: If you overcome a problem or a feeling, you successfully deal with it and control it.

words.tr:
n. 模型；模特；模范；型号；
v. 将…做成模型；当模特；
words.ex: The architect built a model of the new building.
words.ex_cn: 建筑师制作了新大楼的模型。
words.en: A model is a person whose job is to wear and show new styles of clothes and other products, or a representation of something, often on a smaller scale, or a particular design or type of product.

words.ex: My teacher gave me good advice about studying.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师给了我关于学习的好建议。
words.en: If you give someone advice, you tell them what you think they should do in a particular situation.

words.ex: She wore a diamond ring on her finger.
words.ex_cn: 她手指上戴着一枚钻石戒指。
words.en: A diamond is a precious stone consisting of a clear and colorless crystalline form of pure carbon, the hardest naturally occurring substance.

words.tr:
v. 拼写；意味着；
n. 一段时间；
words.ex: Can you spell your name?
words.ex_cn: 你能拼出你的名字吗？
words.en: If you spell a word, you write or speak each letter in the correct order.

words.ex: The number on the door is 5.
words.ex_cn: 门上的数字是5。
words.en: A number is a word or symbol that represents an amount or a quantity.

words.ex: He has seventeen apples in his basket.
words.ex_cn: 他的篮子里有十七个苹果。
words.en: The number seventeen is the natural number following sixteen and preceding eighteen.

words.ex: He is eighteen years old.
words.ex_cn: 他十八岁。
words.en: The number 18.

words.tr:
n. 反面；对立面；
adj. 对面的；
prep. 与…相对；
words.ex: The opposite of black is white.
words.ex_cn: 黑色的反面是白色。
words.en: If one thing is opposite another, it is on the other side of a space from it.

words.ex: Lucas is a common name in the United States.
words.ex_cn: 卢卡斯是美国一个常见的名字。
words.en: lucas

words.ex: Farmers grow corn as a crop.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植玉米作为农作物。
words.en: A crop is a plant such as wheat, potatoes, or cotton that is grown in large quantities by farmers.

words.ex: The manager approved the new project.
words.ex_cn: 经理批准了新项目。
words.en: A manager is a person who is responsible for running part of or the whole of a business organization.

words.ex: He runs a small business selling bread.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家卖面包的小生意。
words.en: Business refers to the activity of buying and selling goods and services, or a particular company that does this.

words.ex: He works for a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司工作。
words.en: A company is a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services.

words.ex: He is a creative boy who draws nice pictures.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有创造力的男孩，会画漂亮的画。
words.en: Someone who is creative has the ability to invent and develop original ideas, especially in the arts.

words.ex: Alan is my neighbor who walks his dog every morning.
words.ex_cn: 艾伦是我的邻居，他每天早上遛狗。
words.en: A male given name, often a short form of Alan or Albert.

words.tr: n. 目标；进球得分；球门；
words.ex: His goal is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A goal is an aim or purpose that a person or a group of people is trying to achieve.

words.ex: His ambition is to become a president.
words.ex_cn: 他的野心是成为总统。
words.en: An ambition is a strong desire to achieve something, typically requiring determination and hard work.

words.ex: The fisherman catches fish every morning.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫每天早上捕鱼。
words.en: A fisherman is a man who catches fish as a job or for sport.

words.ex: The policewoman helped the child find her mom.
words.ex_cn: 女警察帮助孩子找到了她的妈妈。
words.en: A policewoman is a female member of a police force.

words.ex: The artist painted a beautiful landscape.
words.ex_cn: 这位艺术家画了一幅美丽的风景画。
words.en: An artist is someone who draws or paints pictures or creates sculptures as a job or hobby.

words.ex: He made a choice to study hard.
words.ex_cn: 他选择努力学习。
words.en: If you have a choice, you can choose between two or more things.

words.ex: The path leads to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这条路通向村庄。
words.en: A path is a way or track designed for walking or traveling along, especially through the countryside.

words.ex: My teacher is strict about homework deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师对作业截止日期要求很严格。
words.en: If someone is strict, they behave firmly and make sure that rules are obeyed.

words.ex: The teacher will punish the student for cheating.
words.ex_cn: 老师会因为作弊而惩罚那个学生。
words.en: To punish someone means to make them suffer in some way because they have done something wrong.

words.ex: Helen walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 海伦每天早上步行去学校。
words.en: Helen is a female given name derived from the Greek Ἑλένη (Helénē), whose meaning is often associated with 'light' or 'torch'. In Greek mythology, Helen of Troy is the daughter of Zeus and Leda, whose abduction by Paris was the cause of the Trojan War.

words.tr: adj. 充满智慧的；明智的；英明的；
words.ex: The wise old man gave good advice.
words.ex_cn: 这位充满智慧的老人给出了很好的建议。
words.en: If you describe someone as wise, you mean that they have experience, knowledge, and good judgment.

words.ex: He is an actor in a famous movie.
words.ex_cn: 他是电影中的一名演员。
words.en: An actor is a person whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.tr: n. 运输；运输系统；交通工具；
words.ex: The city improved its transportation system.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市改善了它的运输系统。
words.en: Transportation refers to the movement of people, animals, and goods from one place to another.

words.ex: He returned to his hometown after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他毕业后回到了家乡。
words.en: Your hometown is the town or city where you were born or grew up.

words.ex: She was born in Britain.
words.ex_cn: 她出生在英国。
words.en: Britain is a country in Europe consisting of England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland, known for its history, culture, and influence in the world.

words.ex: He seldom eats fast food.
words.ex_cn: 他很少吃快餐。
words.en: If something seldom happens, it happens only occasionally.

words.ex: The car moved at a rapid speed.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车以迅速的速度行驶。
words.en: A rapid change or event happens very quickly.

words.ex: The kettle produces steam when the water boils.
words.ex_cn: 水烧开时，水壶会产生蒸汽。
words.en: Steam is the hot mist that forms when water boils. It can be used to power machines or to cook food.

words.ex: The car has a strong engine.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有一个强劲的发动机。
words.en: An engine is a machine that converts energy into mechanical force and motion.

words.ex: The car has four wheels.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车有四个车轮。
words.en: A wheel is a circular object that revolves on an axle and is fixed below a vehicle or other object to enable it to move easily over the ground.

words.tr: adj. 出生的；天生的； v. 生（孩子）；“bear”的过去分词；
words.ex: He is a born teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是个天生的老师。
words.en: When a baby is born, it comes out of its mother's body at the beginning of its life.

words.ex: The passenger got off the bus at the next stop.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅客在下一站下了车。
words.en: A passenger is a person who is traveling in a vehicle but is not the driver or one of the people who works on it.

words.ex: The train runs on the railway.
words.ex_cn: 火车在铁轨上行驶。
words.en: A railway is a route between two places along which trains travel on steel rails.

words.tr:
adv. 最；
pron. 大部分；
adj. 最多的；大多数的；
words.ex: He is most tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后最累。
words.en: You use most to refer to the majority of a group of things or people or the largest part of something.

words.ex: I wait for the bus at station 15.
words.ex_cn: 我在15号车站等公交车。
words.en: A station is a place where trains, buses, or other vehicles regularly stop so that people can get on or off, or where a particular activity or service is based.

words.ex: He can solve the problem easily.
words.ex_cn: 他很容易就能解决这个问题。
words.en: Without difficulty or effort.

words.tr:
n. 标准；
adj. 标准的；规范的；
words.ex: The school has a high standard for homework.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校对作业有很高的标准。
words.en: A standard is a level of quality or achievement, especially a level that is thought to be acceptable.

words.tr:
n. 速度；速率；
v. 加速；加快；
words.ex: The car's speed was too high on the wet road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在湿滑路面上的速度太快了。
words.en: Speed is the rate at which something moves or happens.

words.ex: The cost is $5 per hour.
words.ex_cn: 每小时费用是5美元。
words.en: Used to express the rate at which something happens or the means by which something is done.

words.ex: Jeremy is a common English name.
words.ex_cn: 杰里米是一个常见的英文名字。
words.en: jeremy

words.ex: The bird spread its wing to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟张开翅膀飞翔。
words.en: One of the two flat parts that stick out from the side of a bird's body and are used for flying.

words.tr:
v. 拉；拖；牵；拔；
n. 拉；拖；牵；拔；
words.ex: He pull the door open.
words.ex_cn: 他拉开了门。
words.en: To pull something means to use your hands to make it move towards you or in the direction that your hands are moving.

words.ex: The farmer drove his cart full of apples to the market.
words.ex_cn: 农夫驾着装满苹果的运货马车去市场。
words.en: A cart is a vehicle with two or four wheels that is pulled by a horse or a person and is used for carrying goods.

words.ex: The boy rides his skateboard to school.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩骑着他的滑板去学校。
words.en: A skateboard is a narrow board with wheels on the bottom that you stand on and ride as a sport or for fun.

words.tr: adj. 能够；能…的；有能力的；
words.ex: He is able to swim across the river.
words.ex_cn: 他能够游过这条河。
words.en: If you are able to do something, you have the skills, strength, knowledge, or other qualities needed to do it.

words.tr:
n. 力量；电源；权力；强国；
v. 给…提供能量；供以动力；
words.ex: The power of the storm broke the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的力量折断了树木。
words.en: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way; control or influence over others; electrical energy supplied to a device or building.

words.ex: The sun appears in the sky at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在黎明时出现。
words.en: If someone or something appears, they come into sight or become noticeable.

words.ex: The factory uses a big machine to make cars.
words.ex_cn: 工厂用一台大机器制造汽车。
words.en: A machine is a piece of equipment which uses electricity or an engine in order to do a particular kind of work.

words.tr:
n. 空间；太空；空格；
v. 以一定间隔排列；
words.ex: The room has enough space for a bed and a desk.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有足够的空间放一张床和一张书桌。
words.en: Space refers to the physical dimensions in which objects exist and move, including the vast expanse beyond the Earth's atmosphere, known as outer space. It can also denote the interval or distance between two or more objects, or a period of time. As a verb, it means to arrange with spaces in between.

words.ex: The spaceship flew to the moon.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙飞船飞到了月球。
words.en: A spacecraft designed for travel or operation in outer space.

words.ex: Can you imagine a world without phones?
words.ex_cn: 你能想象一个没有电话的世界吗？
words.en: To imagine means to form a mental image or concept of something that is not present or real.

words.ex: He protects the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
words.en: The environment is the natural world in which people, animals, and plants live.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.ex: The telephone was a great invention.
words.ex_cn: 电话是一项伟大的发明。
words.en: An invention is a unique or novel device, method, composition or process. It may be an improvement upon a machine or product, or a new process for creating an object or a result. An invention that achieves a completely unique function or result may be a radical breakthrough. Such works are novel and not obvious to others skilled in the same field.

words.ex: He carries his books in a backpack.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在背包里。
words.en: A backpack is a bag with straps that go over your shoulders, so that you can carry things on your back.

words.ex: He made a box from cardboard.
words.ex_cn: 他用纸板做了一个盒子。
words.en: Cardboard is a stiff, heavy paper material that is used for making boxes and other packaging.

words.tr:
n. 燃料；燃油；
v. 加剧；
words.ex: The rocket uses fuel 627 for propulsion.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用627号燃料推进。
words.en: Fuel is a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that is burned to provide heat or power.

words.ex: She put oil on the pan before cooking.
words.ex_cn: 她在锅里倒了油再做饭。
words.en: Oil is a liquid that is used as a fuel and for lubricating the moving parts of machines.

words.ex: He will probably come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能来参加派对。
words.en: Used to say that something is likely to be true or likely to happen.

words.ex: Children have a strong imagination.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们有很强的想象力。
words.en: The ability to form pictures or ideas in your mind of things that are new and exciting, or not real.

words.tr: n. 山姆（注：Sam也可以作女名使用）；
words.ex: Sam is my neighbor who loves gardening.
words.ex_cn: 山姆是我的邻居，喜欢园艺。
words.en: A male given name, often a short form of Samuel or Simon; also used as a common name for characters in stories.

words.ex: He enjoyed riding his hoverboard around the park.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在公园里骑他的悬滑板。
words.en: A hoverboard is a levitating board used for personal transportation, as if in science fiction.

words.tr:
adj. 平滑的；平坦的；
v. 使平滑；
words.ex: The glass surface is smooth.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃表面是平滑的。
words.en: Having an even and regular surface or consistency; free from projections, indentations, or roughness.

words.ex: The boat floats on the water.
words.ex_cn: 船在水面上浮动。
words.en: To float means to stay on the surface of a liquid and not sink, or to move slowly in the air or on water.

words.ex: The transporter is used to move goods from one place to another.
words.ex_cn: 输送机用于将货物从一个地方运送到另一个地方。
words.en: A transporter is a person or thing that transports goods or people from one place to another.

words.tr: v. 允许；留出；给予；承认；
words.ex: My parents allow me to go out on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母允许我周末外出。
words.en: If someone is allowed to do something, it is all right for them to do it and they will not get into trouble.

words.tr:
n. 形式；表格；形状；
v. 组成；建立；
words.ex: The form of the poem is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的形式非常简单。
words.en: A form is a particular way in which a thing exists or appears, or a document with spaces in which to write information.

words.ex: He pressed the pedal to speed up the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他踩下踏板让自行车加速。
words.en: A pedal is a lever that you press with your foot in order to control a vehicle or machine.

words.ex: He is taller than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他比他弟弟高。
words.en: used to introduce the second element in a comparison

words.ex: China uses a lot of energy from coal.
words.ex_cn: 中国使用大量煤炭能源。
words.en: Energy is the ability and strength to do active physical things and the feeling that you are full of physical power and life.

words.ex: He reads books as a hobby.
words.ex_cn: 他读书作为一种爱好。
words.en: A hobby is an activity that you enjoy doing in your spare time.

words.tr:
v. 抽出；节省；
adj. 备用的；多余的；空闲的；
words.ex: Can you spare a few minutes to help me?
words.ex_cn: 你能抽出几分钟帮我吗？
words.en: If you have something such as time, money, or space to spare, you have some extra time, money, or space that you have not used or which you do not need.

words.ex: The earth goes around the sun.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕太阳运转。
words.en: The planet on which we live; the land surface of the world as distinct from the sea or the air.

words.ex: He collects stamps every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周收集邮票。
words.en: If you collect a number of things, you gather them together, usually because you want them for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The boy picked up a stone from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从地上捡起一块石头。
words.en: A stone is a small piece of rock that is found on the ground.

words.tr: n. 音乐会；演奏会；一致；和谐；
words.ex: We went to a concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去听了音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.ex: He bought a ticket for the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张电影票。
words.en: A ticket is a small, official piece of paper or card which shows that you have paid to enter a place such as a theatre or a sports ground, or shows that you have paid for a journey.

words.tr:
n. 贸易；交易；行业；
v. 贸易；交易；
words.ex: The two countries increased their trade last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这两个国家增加了贸易。
words.en: Trade involves the buying and selling of goods and services. It can refer to the exchange of goods and services between parties, or to the business of buying and selling goods and services.

words.ex: She plants flowers in her garden.
words.ex_cn: 她在花园里种花。
words.en: A garden is a piece of land next to a house, with flowers, vegetables, other plants, and often grass.

words.ex: He spoke with confidence during the presentation.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲时充满信心。
words.en: Confidence is a feeling of self-assurance arising from one's appreciation of one's own abilities or qualities.

words.ex: He sent a postcard from Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他从巴黎寄了一张明信片。
words.en: A postcard is a piece of thick paper or thin cardboard, typically rectangular, intended for writing and mailing without an envelope and at a lower rate than a letter.

words.ex: We had an outdoor picnic last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 上个星期天我们进行了户外野餐。
words.en: relating to or done in the open air; not inside a building

words.ex: The rex ruled the land with wisdom.
words.ex_cn: 国王以智慧统治这片土地。
words.en: A title used for a king, especially in ancient Rome or in reference to a king in a general sense.

words.tr:
adj. 巨大的；伟大的；
n. 巨人；伟人；
words.ex: The giant elephant stood near the tree.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的大象站在树旁。
words.en: A giant is an imaginary person who is very big and strong, especially one mentioned in old stories. In everyday language, a giant can also refer to a very large and successful company or organization.

words.ex: The dog is huge.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗很大。
words.en: Extremely large in size or amount.

words.tr:
adj. 非洲的；非洲人的；
n. 非洲人；
words.ex: He loves African music and dance.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢非洲的音乐和舞蹈。
words.en: Relating to Africa or its people, culture, or languages.

words.ex: The hen is laying eggs in the coop.
words.ex_cn: 母鸡正在鸡舍里下蛋。
words.en: A hen is a female chicken, especially one that is kept for its eggs.

words.ex: I don't like coffee anymore.
words.ex_cn: 我不再喜欢咖啡了。
words.en: If something does not happen or is not true anymore, it has stopped happening or is no longer true.

words.tr:
v. 发射；发起；启动；
n. 发射；投掷；启动；
words.ex: They will launch a rocket tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将发射一枚火箭。
words.en: To launch something means to send it into the air, space, or water, especially with a lot of force or effort, or to start an activity, event, or project.

words.tr:
n. 成人；
adj. 成年的；
words.ex: An adult must pay taxes.
words.ex_cn: 成人必须缴税。
words.en: An adult is a mature, fully developed person. An adult has reached the age when they are legally responsible for their actions.

words.tr:
v. 打破；打断；
n. 休息；中断；破裂；
words.ex: He broke the glass by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心打破了玻璃。
words.en: If you break something, you cause it to separate into two or more pieces, often in a way that is irreparable.

words.tr:
n. 土地；陆地；
v. 降落；着陆；
words.ex: The farmer owns a large piece of land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民拥有一大片土地。
words.en: Land is an area of ground, especially one that is used for a particular purpose such as farming or building.

words.tr: adj. 有挑战性的； v. 提出挑战；“challenge”的现在分词；
words.ex: The math problem was challenging.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学题很有挑战性。
words.en: If you describe something as challenging, you mean that it tests your ability and determination and that you need to work hard to deal with it or achieve it.

words.tr:
n. 旋转；
v. 旋转；
words.ex: The spin of the top made it stay upright.
words.ex_cn: 陀螺的旋转让它保持直立。
words.en: If something spins or if you spin it, it turns quickly around a central point.

words.ex: His performance in the game was excellent.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中的表现非常出色。
words.en: The act of performing a play, concert, or some other form of entertainment.

words.tr: adj. 常见的；普通的；共有的；
words.ex: Colds are a common illness in winter.
words.ex_cn: 感冒在冬天是很常见的疾病。
words.en: Something that is common happens often or is found in many places.

words.tr: adj. 真实的；真的；真正的；
words.ex: This is a real diamond, not fake.
words.ex_cn: 这是一颗真正的钻石，不是假的。
words.en: Something that is real actually exists and is not imagined, invented, or theoretical.

words.tr:
v. 支持；支撑；
n. 拥护；帮助；
words.ex: My friends support me when I feel sad.
words.ex_cn: 当我感到难过时，我的朋友们支持我。
words.en: If you support someone or their ideas or aims, you agree with them, and perhaps help them because you want them to succeed.

words.tr:
adj. 每天的；每日的；
adv. 每天；每日；
n. 日报；
words.ex: He drinks water daily.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝水。
words.en: Something that happens or is done daily happens or is done every day.

words.ex: This painting is unique because no other like it exists.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是独特的，因为没有其他类似的。
words.en: Something that is unique is the only one of its kind.

words.ex: I suppose he is late because of the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我认为他因为交通堵塞而迟到了。
words.en: If you suppose that something is true, you believe or imagine that it is true, although you may not have any proof.

words.ex: We cleaned the house ourselves.
words.ex_cn: 我们自己打扫了房子。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition when this is the same as the subject of the clause and the subject is the speaker and one or more other people considered together.

words.ex: A kind person helped me find my way.
words.ex_cn: 一位善良的人帮我找到了路。
words.en: A human being regarded as an individual.

words.ex: He has a talent for playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他有弹钢琴的才能。
words.en: If someone has a talent for something, they have a natural ability to do it well.

words.ex: This is my personal notebook.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的个人笔记本。
words.en: Relating to or belonging to a particular person rather than to a group or an organization.

words.ex: His strength helped him lift the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他的力量让他举起了那个重箱子。
words.en: The quality or state of being physically strong.

words.tr:
n. 意义；感知；理解力；知觉；
v. 感觉到；觉察出；意识到；
words.ex: The story has no sense.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事没有意义。
words.en: A sense is a feeling or awareness about something, or a physical ability such as sight, hearing, touch, taste, or smell.

words.tr: n. 格鲁吉亚（前苏联加盟共和国）；乔治亚州；乔治娅（女子名）
words.ex: Georgia is known for its beautiful landscapes and rich history.
words.ex_cn: 格鲁吉亚以其美丽的风景和丰富的历史而闻名。
words.en: Georgia is a state located in the southeastern region of the United States, known for its diverse landscapes and rich history. It is also the name of a country in the Caucasus region of Eurasia.

words.ex: He visited Greece last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了希腊。
words.en: Greece is a country in southeastern Europe with thousands of islands throughout the Aegean and Ionian seas. It's often called the cradle of Western civilization, and Athens, its capital, retains landmarks including the 5th-century B.C. Acropolis citadel with the Parthenon temple.

words.ex: Nobody knows the answer.
words.ex_cn: 没有人知道答案。
words.en: Nobody means not any person or no person.

words.tr:
n. 返回；归还；
v. 返回；归还；
words.ex: The return of the train was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 火车的返回被推迟了。
words.en: To go or come back to a place or person. To give, send, or put something back to its original place or condition.

words.tr:
adj. 希腊的；
n. 希腊语；
words.ex: He loves eating Greek food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吃的希腊食物。
words.en: Relating to Greece, its people, or their language.

words.tr:
adj. （职位或等级）较低的；年幼的；（高中、大学的）三年级学生；
n. 年幼者；
words.ex: He is a junior employee in the company.
words.ex_cn: 他是公司里职位较低的员工。
words.en: A junior person is younger or has a lower position than another person.

words.ex: He will continue walking after the break.
words.ex_cn: 休息后他会继续走路。
words.en: If someone or something continues to do something, they keep doing it and do not stop.

words.ex: He will sue the company for damages.
words.ex_cn: 他将起诉这家公司要求赔偿。
words.en: To sue means to start a legal case against someone, usually to claim money from them because they have caused you harm or loss.

words.tr:
n. 平均数；平均水平；
adj. 平均的；普通的；
v. 平均为…；
words.ex: The average of 4, 5, and 6 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 4、5和6的平均数是5。
words.en: An average is the result that you get when you add two or more numbers together and divide the total by the number of numbers you added together.

words.ex: He made a stupid mistake on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中犯了一个愚蠢的错误。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is stupid, you mean that they show a lack of good judgment or intelligence and they are not at all sensible.

words.tr: adj. 聪明的；时髦的；衣冠楚楚的；
words.ex: He is a smart student who solves math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个聪明的学生，能快速解决数学问题。
words.en: If you describe someone as smart, you mean that they are clean, tidy, and stylish in their appearance.

words.ex: It is impossible to finish the race in five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 五分钟内完成比赛是不可能的。
words.en: If something is impossible, it cannot be done or cannot happen.

words.ex: He feels weak after the long illness.
words.ex_cn: 这场大病之后，他感到虚弱。
words.en: If someone is weak, they are not physically strong or healthy.

words.ex: She looked at herself in the mirror.
words.ex_cn: 她对着镜子看自己。
words.en: A mirror is a flat piece of glass which reflects light, so that when you look at it you can see yourself reflected in it.

words.ex: He spoke into the microphone to be heard clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他对着麦克风说话，以便被清楚地听到。
words.en: A microphone is a device that is used to make sounds louder or to record them.

words.tr:
n. 节目；程序；
v. 编程；
words.ex: We watched a funny program on TV last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在电视上看了一个有趣的节目。
words.en: A program is a set of instructions that a computer follows in order to perform a particular task.

words.ex: He is confident when he speaks in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他在全班面前说话时很自信。
words.en: If you are confident, you are certain of your abilities or of your beliefs.

words.tr:
n. 声音；意见；
v. 表达；
words.ex: I heard a loud voice from the next room.
words.ex_cn: 我听到隔壁房间传来很大的声音。
words.en: Your voice is the sound that you make when you speak or sing.

words.tr: adj. 优秀的；杰出的；卓越的；
words.ex: He got an excellent score on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中取得了优异的成绩。
words.en: Something that is excellent is very good indeed.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；舞台；
v. 举行；上演；
words.ex: This is a critical stage in his recovery.
words.ex_cn: 这是他康复过程中的一个关键阶段。
words.en: A stage is a raised area in a theatre or hall where performers, speakers, or entertainers stand. It can also refer to a particular point or period in the development or progress of something.

words.ex: He felt a pain in his heart.
words.ex_cn: 他感到心脏疼痛。
words.en: The heart is the organ in your chest that pumps the blood around your body. People also use heart to refer to the area of their chest that is closest to their heart.

words.tr:
v. 打；敲打；击败；
n. 一击；跳动；
words.ex: He beat the drum loudly.
words.ex_cn: 他用力敲打鼓。
words.en: To defeat someone in a game, competition, election, or battle; to hit someone or something many times with your hand, a stick, etc.

words.ex: He walks slowly to enjoy the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地走，以便欣赏日落。
words.en: If you do something slowly, you do it at a low speed.

words.ex: She cleaned the room herself.
words.ex_cn: 她自己打扫了房间。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition when the female subject of the verb is also the object.

words.ex: Peter is playing soccer in the park.
words.ex_cn: 彼得正在公园里踢足球。
words.en: If something peters out, it gradually becomes smaller, less, weaker, or less important until it ends or disappears completely.

words.ex: He didn't give up, even though some called him a loser.
words.ex_cn: 他没有放弃，即使有些人称他为失败者。
words.en: A loser is someone who is not successful in a particular situation or who does not achieve what they set out to do.

words.tr: v. 无法做到；失败；不及格；倒闭；
words.ex: He failed to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他没能完成比赛。
words.en: If you fail to do something that you were trying to do, you are unable to do it or do not succeed in doing it.

words.ex: Krista is a talented musician who plays multiple instruments.
words.ex_cn: 克里斯塔是一位多才多艺的音乐家，她能演奏多种乐器。
words.en: krista

words.tr: n. 墨西哥（拉丁美洲国家）
words.ex: He lives in Mexico.
words.ex_cn: 他住在墨西哥。
words.en: Mexico is a country in the southern part of North America.

words.tr: v. 拼写错( misspell的过去式和过去分词 )
words.ex: He misspelled the word 'accommodate'.
words.ex_cn: 他把'accommodate'这个词拼错了。
words.en: If a word is misspelled, it is not spelled correctly.

words.ex: He accepted the gift with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着接受了这份礼物。
words.en: If you accept something that you have been offered, you say yes to it or agree to take it.

words.tr:
n. 奖品；裁定；
v. 授予；
words.ex: He received an award for best student.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了最佳学生奖。
words.en: An award is a prize or other mark of recognition given in honor of an achievement.

words.ex: He works at a small college.
words.ex_cn: 他在一所小型学院工作。
words.en: A college is an institution where students study after they have left school, in order to get a degree or qualification.

words.tr: 短语 一个……另一个……（用于对比或分别指代两个人或事物）
words.ex: I have two books: one is red and the other is blue.
words.ex_cn: 我有两本书：一本是红色的，另一本是蓝色的。
words.en: Used to refer to two different things or people, one thing or person and another thing or person.

words.ex: He will introduce his friend to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他将向全班介绍他的朋友。
words.en: If you introduce someone, you tell someone else their name so that they can know each other.

words.ex: I advise you to eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 我建议你多吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you advise someone to do something, you tell them what you think they should do.

words.tr: phrase. 由…决定；是…的职责；从事；胜任
words.ex_cn: 这个周末你打算做什么？
words.en: Used to ask or talk about what someone is doing or planning to do.

words.tr: phrase. 赞同； 同意； 适合于
words.ex: I agree with you on this point.
words.ex_cn: 我同意你的这个观点。
words.en: to have the same opinion as someone else; to accept a suggestion or idea

words.ex: Go ahead, the path is clear.
words.ex_cn: 前进吧，路是畅通的。
words.en: To proceed or continue with something without hesitation.

words.tr: phrase. 拉小提琴；演奏小提琴
words.ex: He plays the violin every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉小提琴。
words.en: To perform music on a violin by using a bow to draw sound from its strings.

words.tr: phrase. 一模一样的两个人（或物）；形影不离的伙伴
words.ex: They are like two peas in a pod, always dressing the same.
words.ex_cn: 他们如出一辙，总是穿得一模一样。
words.en: If you say that two people are like two peas in a pod, you mean that they are very similar in appearance or character.

words.ex: He spends money on books.
words.ex_cn: 他花钱买书。
words.en: To spend means to use money to buy or pay for something, or to use time or energy in a particular way.

words.ex: To my surprise, he passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 让我惊讶的是，他通过了考试。
words.en: used to express that someone is surprised by something

words.tr: phrase. 成交；达成交易；订个协议
words.ex: They make a deal to share the cookies.
words.ex_cn: 他们达成协议分享饼干。
words.en: To reach an agreement or arrangement, especially in business.

words.tr: phrase. 感到幸运能做某事
words.ex: I feel lucky to help my friends.
words.ex_cn: 我觉得能帮助朋友很幸运。
words.en: to consider oneself fortunate to perform an action

words.ex: My teacher encourages me to speak English every day.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师鼓励我每天说英语。
words.en: If you encourage someone, you give them confidence, for example by letting them know that what they are doing is good and telling them that they should continue to do it.

words.ex: He plays the piano every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上弹钢琴。
words.en: To perform music on the piano.

words.w: have the pleasure of doing something
words.tr: 短语动词. 有幸做某事；荣幸地做某事
words.uk: hæv ðə ˈpleʒər əv ˈduːɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.us: hæv ðə ˈplɛʒər əv ˈduɪŋ ˈsʌmθɪŋ
words.ex: I have the pleasure of meeting my favorite teacher today.
words.ex_cn: 今天我很荣幸见到了我最喜欢的老师。
words.en: To have the opportunity or good fortune to do something, often implying that the activity is enjoyable or an honor.

words.ex: He is late for school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都上学迟到。
words.en: To arrive somewhere after the expected or usual time.

words.tr: phrase. 在两分钟内；两分钟后
words.ex: I can finish this task in two minutes.
words.ex_cn: 我可以在两分钟内完成这项任务。
words.en: Indicates that something will happen after a period of two minutes.

words.ex: He likes physical education because he plays basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢体育课，因为他打篮球。
words.en: Physical education is the training and care of the body to improve strength and fitness, especially through exercise and sports.

words.tr: abbr. 体育教育；“physical education”的缩写
words.ex: He plays basketball in p.e. class.
words.ex_cn: 他在体育课上打篮球。
words.en: Physical Education, a subject in school that involves physical activities and sports.

words.tr: phrase. 缺课；旷课；错过上课
words.ex: He missed class because he was sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病而没上课。
words.en: To fail to attend a class or lecture.

words.ex: She had to miss school because of her illness.
words.ex_cn: 她因为生病不得不缺课。
words.en: To fail to attend school.

words.tr:
n. 咳嗽；
v. 咳嗽；
words.ex: He had a bad cough last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚咳得很厉害。
words.en: A cough is a sudden, forceful expulsion of air from the lungs, often caused by irritation in the airway.

words.ex: I do not like spinach at all.
words.ex_cn: 我一点也不喜欢菠菜。
words.en: Used to emphasize that you are not in the least bit tired, interested, etc.

words.ex: This store is convenient for buying groceries.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店买杂货很方便。
words.en: If something is convenient, it is easy to use or do, or it is useful and suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The noise from the street kept me awake.
words.ex_cn: 街道上的噪声让我睡不着。
words.en: Noise is a sound, especially one that is loud, unpleasant, or disturbing.

words.tr: phrase. 四分之一；一刻钟；二十五分硬币
words.ex: He ate a quarter of the pizza.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了四分之一的披萨。
words.en: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something.

words.tr: phrase. 母亲节（现代的母亲节起源于美国，是每年5月的第二个星期日。母亲们在这一天通常会收到礼物，康乃馨
words.ex: She gives her mom a card on mother's day.
words.ex_cn: 她在母亲节给妈妈一张卡片。
words.en: Mother's Day is a celebration honoring the mother of the family, as well as motherhood, maternal bonds, and the influence of mothers in society. It is celebrated on various days in many parts of the world, most commonly in the months of March or May.

words.ex: He gave his dad a card on father's day.
words.ex_cn: 他在父亲节给了爸爸一张卡片。
words.en: Father's Day is a day on which people give cards and gifts to their fathers as a way of showing their love and appreciation.

words.ex: Please remind me to call my mom tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 请提醒我明天给我妈妈打电话。
words.en: If someone reminds you of a fact or event that you already know about, they say something which makes you think about it.

words.ex: We eat mooncakes during the mid-autumn festival.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中秋节吃月饼。
words.en: The Mid-Autumn Festival, also known as the Moon Festival, is a traditional festival celebrated by Chinese and Vietnamese people. It is held on the 15th day of the 8th month of the lunar calendar with a full moon at night, symbolizing reunion and harvest.

words.ex: He likes fruits such as apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果和香蕉这样的水果。
words.en: Used to introduce examples of something that has been mentioned.

words.tr: phrase. 太……而不能……（用于表达程度过高导致无法做某事）
words.ex: He is too tired to walk.
words.ex_cn: 他太累了，走不动了。
words.en: Used to say that something is not possible because a quality or condition is too extreme.

words.ex: The new rules add to the cost.
words.ex_cn: 新规定增加了成本。
words.en: To put something together with something else so as to increase the size, number, or amount.

words.ex: They talked face to face instead of on the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他们面对面交谈，而不是打电话。
words.en: If you meet or talk to someone face to face, you meet or talk to them directly, rather than by telephone, email, or online.

words.ex: I stay in touch with my old friends by texting.
words.ex_cn: 我通过发短信和老朋友保持联系。
words.en: To maintain communication or contact with someone.

words.ex: This box is the same size as that one.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子和那个盒子一样大。
words.en: Used to indicate that two objects have identical dimensions.

words.ex: She wants to try on the new dress.
words.ex_cn: 她想试穿那条新裙子。
words.en: To put on a piece of clothing to see if it fits or if you like it.

words.tr: phrase. 给……一个大大的拥抱
words.ex: I give my mom a big hug every time I come home.
words.ex_cn: 每次我回家时都会给妈妈一个大大的拥抱。
words.en: to embrace someone warmly and affectionately

words.tr: 短语. 向……致以最美好的祝愿
words.ex: I send best wishes to you for your exam.
words.ex_cn: 我祝你考试顺利。
words.en: expressions of hope for someone's happiness and success

words.tr: phrase. 在…的顶部；在…之上；完全掌控；除…之外
words.ex: She placed the book on the top of the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 她把书放在书架的顶部。
words.en: On the top of means at the highest part or point of something, or in addition to.

words.ex: He has already finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他已经完成了他的作业。
words.en: You use already to say that something has happened, or that something had happened before the moment you are referring to.

words.tr: 短语动词. 没有运气；不成功
words.ex: He has no luck finding his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他找不到他的钥匙。
words.en: To be unsuccessful in one's endeavors, often due to chance or fate.

words.ex: Wearing blue jeans is in fashion now.
words.ex_cn: 现在穿牛仔裤很流行。
words.en: If something is in fashion, it is popular or considered to be attractive at a particular time.

words.ex: Please turn off the light before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前请关灯。
words.en: If you turn off a device or machine, you stop it from operating by pressing a button or moving a switch.

words.ex: Close your eyes and make a wish.
words.ex_cn: 闭上眼睛许个愿。
words.en: To express a desire for something that is not easily attainable or that one hopes will happen.

words.tr: phrase. 吹灭；爆裂；突然冒出
words.ex: He will blow out the candle on his birthday cake.
words.ex_cn: 他会在生日蛋糕上吹灭蜡烛。
words.en: To extinguish something by blowing, or to burst suddenly.

words.ex: He went past the store without stopping.
words.ex_cn: 他经过商店却没有停下。
words.en: To move past something or someone; to exceed a certain point in time or space.

words.ex: Time goes by quickly when you are happy.
words.ex_cn: 当你开心时，时间过得很快。
words.en: If you say that time goes by, you mean that it passes.

words.ex: She served tea biscuits with her afternoon tea.
words.ex_cn: 她下午茶时端上了佐茶饼干。
words.en: A tea biscuit is a type of biscuit that is typically served with tea.

words.tr: phrase. 迷路的；迷失的；不知所措的
words.ex: He was lost in the woods.
words.ex_cn: 他在森林中迷路了。
words.en: To be unable to find one's way or to be confused about what to do or say.

words.tr: phrase. v. 走开，消失；迷路
words.ex: He told the noisy boy to get lost.
words.ex_cn: 他让那个吵闹的男孩走开。
words.en: If you tell someone to get lost, you are telling them in a rude way to go away.

words.w: can you tell me the way to ...
words.tr: phrase. 你能告诉我去……的路吗
words.uk: kæn juː tel miː ðə weɪ tuː
words.us: kæn ju tel mi ðə weɪ tu
words.ex: Can you tell me the way to the bus stop?
words.ex_cn: 你能告诉我去公交站的路吗？
words.en: asking for directions to a specific place

words.tr: adj. 角的；有角的；尖角的；
words.ex: The angular shape of the triangle is clear.
words.ex_cn: 三角形的角形很清晰。
words.en: having angles or sharp corners; lean and bony

words.tr: v. 离开；“leave”的过去式和过去分词； n. 左；左边； adj. 左边的； adv. 向左；在左边；
words.ex: He left the house early this morning.
words.ex_cn: 他今天早上早早离开了家。
words.en: If there is a certain amount of something left, or if you have a certain amount of it left, it remains when the rest has gone or been used.

words.tr: 短语，距离……几个街区；表示与某地相隔几个城市街区的距离
words.ex: The store is only a few blocks from here.
words.ex_cn: 商店离这里只有几条街。
words.en: A short distance away from a place, typically measured in city blocks.

words.tr: 短语. 距离几个街区远；离……有几个街区的距离
words.ex: The store is only two blocks away from the park.
words.ex_cn: 商店离公园只有两个街区远。
words.en: A short distance away from a place, typically measured in blocks (urban units of streets).

words.ex_cn: 他正在忙着做作业。
words.en: To be occupied or actively engaged in doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 听起来像；似乎像（用于描述某事物给人的听觉印象或感觉）
words.ex: It sounds like rain outside.
words.ex_cn: 外面听起来像下雨了。
words.en: To seem to be something when heard.

words.ex: I'm doing well, thank you.
words.ex_cn: 我很好，谢谢。
words.en: A polite and common response to 'How are you?' indicating that one is in good health or spirits.

words.tr: 短语动词. 患流感；得了流感
words.ex: I can't go to work today because I have the flu.
words.ex_cn: v. 我今天不能去上班，因为我患了流感。
words.en: To be suffering from influenza, a viral infection that causes fever, aching, coughing, and general malaise.

words.tr: phrase. 在……对面；与……隔街相对
words.ex: The bank is across from the post office.
words.ex_cn: 银行在邮局的对面。
words.en: prep. on the opposite side of something

words.tr: 短语动词. 做一次演讲；发表讲话
words.ex: He will give a talk about science tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天将做一场关于科学的演讲。
words.en: To deliver a formal speech or presentation to an audience.

words.ex: You should be nice to your classmates.
words.ex_cn: 你应该对你的同学友好。
words.en: To treat someone in a kind and pleasant way.

words.ex: He wants to grow up and be a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他想长大后当一名医生。
words.en: To grow up means to gradually change from being a child to being an adult. This process involves physical, emotional, and intellectual development.

words.ex: He feels dizzy because of his acrophobia when he looks down from the tall building.
words.ex_cn: 他从高楼往下看时因为恐高而感到头晕。
words.en: An extreme or irrational fear of heights.

words.ex: He stopped doing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他停止做作业了。
words.en: To cease performing a particular action or activity.

words.ex: The rain stopped us from playing outside.
words.ex_cn: 下雨让我们没法在外面玩。
words.en: To prevent someone or something from doing a particular thing.

words.tr: phrase. 采取措施以；着手做某事
words.ex: They take steps to save water every day.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天采取措施节约用水。
words.en: If you take steps to do something, you start to do what is necessary to achieve it.

words.ex: My teacher gave me good advice about studying.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师给了我关于学习的好建议。
words.en: If you give someone advice, you tell them what you think they should do in a particular situation.

words.ex: He runs a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家小咖啡店。
words.en: To operate or manage a business, company, or organization.

words.ex: I will help you, no matter what.
words.ex_cn: 无论怎样，我都会帮你。
words.en: Regardless of what happens or what the circumstances are.

words.ex: He goes to school on foot.
words.ex_cn: 他步行去学校。
words.en: By walking.

words.ex: The steam engine moved the train on old tracks.
words.ex_cn: 蒸汽机车在旧轨道上行驶。
words.en: A steam engine is a heat engine that performs mechanical work using steam as its working fluid.

words.ex: He was born in a small town.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小镇上。
words.en: To come into existence through birth.

words.ex: How is your project getting on?
words.ex_cn: 你的项目进展如何？
words.en: If you get on with someone, you have a friendly relationship with them. If you get on with something, you continue doing it or start doing it.

words.ex: He gets off the bus at the school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校下车。
words.en: To leave a place, especially in order to start a journey; to remove something, especially clothing.

words.ex: He is able to swim very well.
words.ex_cn: 他能游得很好。
words.en: To have the power, skill, means, or opportunity to do something.

words.ex: He stays up late to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他熬夜完成作业。
words.en: To remain awake and active until late at night.

words.tr: phrase. 开启；接通；发动；突击
words.ex: He turns on the light in the room.
words.ex_cn: 他打开了房间的灯。
words.en: To cause something to start operating, especially by pressing a switch or button.

words.w: travel at the speed of light
words.tr: phrase. 以光速行进；比喻极快地移动或传播
words.ex: In science fiction, spaceships often travel at the speed of light.
words.ex_cn: 在科幻小说中，宇宙飞船经常以光速行进。
words.en: To move or go at the speed of light, which is approximately 299,792 kilometers per second in a vacuum.

words.ex: He is talking all the time.
words.ex_cn: 他一直在说话。
words.en: If something happens or is done all the time, it happens or is done continually or repeatedly.

words.ex: From now on, I will study every day.
words.ex_cn: 从现在开始，我会每天学习。
words.en: Starting from this moment and continuing into the future.

words.tr: phrase. 想到；想起；有...的看法
words.ex: I think of my mom when I eat cookies.
words.ex_cn: 当我吃饼干时，我想起我的妈妈。
words.en: To have a particular idea or opinion about something or someone; to consider something or someone in a particular way.

words.ex: He decided to jump down from the high wall.
words.ex_cn: 他决定从高墙上跳下来。
words.en: To move quickly off the ground or from a higher position to a lower one by pushing oneself with the legs.

words.ex: He has more than three books.
words.ex_cn: 他有三本书以上。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is greater in amount, degree, or number than something else or than expected.

words.tr: phrase. 在某人的空闲时间；闲暇时
words.ex: He likes to read books in his free time.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间喜欢读书。
words.en: During the time when one is not working or occupied; leisure time.

words.tr: phrase. 在某人的闲暇时间；在某人空闲的时候
words.ex: He reads books in his spare time.
words.ex_cn: 他在空闲时间读书。
words.en: During one's free time; when one is not working or occupied with other duties.

words.ex: She is interested in learning new languages.
words.ex_cn: 她对学习新语言感兴趣。
words.en: To have a feeling of curiosity or concern about something, leading to a desire to learn or know more about it.

words.tr: phrase. 各种各样的；各种类型的
words.ex: He collects all kinds of stamps.
words.ex_cn: 他收集各种各样的邮票。
words.en: A phrase used to indicate a variety of different types or kinds of something.

words.ex: Not only does he play the piano, but also he sings well.
words.ex_cn: 他不仅会弹钢琴，而且唱得也很好。
words.en: Used to emphasize that two things are true, especially when this is surprising or impressive.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.ex: His great-great-grandfather was a prominent figure in the early 19th century.
words.ex_cn: 他的高曾祖父是19世纪初的一位杰出人物。
words.en: A great-great-grandfather is the grandfather of one of your grandparents.

words.tr: phrase. 感到自豪；感到骄傲
words.ex: He feels proud when he helps others.
words.ex_cn: 当他帮助别人时，他感到自豪。
words.en: To experience a feeling of pride or satisfaction in oneself or one's achievements.

words.ex: He no longer plays soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他不再踢足球了。
words.en: If something is no longer the case, it is not the case now, although it was the case in the past.

words.tr: 由……制成（表示材料，强调原材料未发生根本性变化）
words.ex: The table is made of wood.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是木头做的。
words.en: If something is made of a particular material, that material was used to build it.

words.tr: phrase. 建造得最精良的火箭
words.ex: The best-built rocket in history was launched successfully.
words.ex_cn: 历史上建造得最好的火箭成功发射了。
words.en: A rocket that is constructed with the highest quality materials and craftsmanship, making it superior in performance and durability compared to others.

words.tr: phrase. 上上下下；前前后后
words.ex: The ball goes up and down when he throws it.
words.ex_cn: 当他扔球时，球上下弹跳。
words.en: Moving alternately upwards and downwards or back and forth.

words.ex: The car is in the parking lot.
words.ex_cn: 车在停车场里。
words.en: A parking lot is an area of ground where people can leave their cars.

words.tr: phrase. 把…侧放；使…侧翻；将…侧过来放置
words.ex: He put the bottle on its side so it would roll.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子放倒，这样它就能滚动了。
words.en: To place something so that its side is facing upwards or outwards.

words.tr: phrase. 经历；仔细检查；完成；通过；穿过
words.ex: He went through a hard time last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一段艰难的时光。
words.en: To experience something, often something difficult or unpleasant, or to examine or discuss something in detail.

words.tr: phrase. （非正式）怎么了？/ 有什么事？/ 最近怎么样？
words.ex: What's up? He just smiled and said nothing.
words.ex_cn: 怎么了？他只是笑了笑，什么也没说。
words.en: An informal greeting or inquiry meaning 'How are you?' or 'What is happening?

words.ex: The ship sent an SOS signal after it hit an iceberg.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船在撞上冰山后发出了SOS信号。
words.en: An internationally recognized signal of distress in radio code.

words.ex: He is supposed to finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他本该在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: If you are supposed to do something, it means that you are expected or required to do it.

words.tr: phrase. 讲得通； 有意义； 言之有理
words.ex: This plan makes sense.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划有道理。
words.en: To be reasonable or understandable.

words.tr: phrase. 不用谢；这是我的荣幸；乐意效劳
words.ex: When someone thanks you, you can respond with 'It's my pleasure.'
words.ex_cn: 当有人感谢你时，你可以回答说：'这是我的荣幸。'
words.en: A polite expression used to respond to thanks or to offer help, indicating that the speaker is happy to do something.

words.ex: He continues doing his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后继续做作业。
words.en: To persist in an activity or process without interruption.

words.ex: He decided to continue to do his research despite the difficulties.
words.ex_cn: 尽管困难重重，他决定继续他的研究。
words.en: To keep doing something without stopping.

words.ex: His strong points include excellent communication skills and a strong work ethic.
words.ex_cn: 他的长处包括出色的沟通能力和强烈的工作道德。
words.en: The aspects or qualities of someone or something that are particularly good or effective.

words.ex: Identifying and addressing weak points is crucial for personal growth.
words.ex_cn: 识别并解决弱点对个人成长至关重要。
words.en: Weak points refer to the aspects or areas in which someone or something is less strong or effective than other aspects or areas.

words.tr: phrase. 梦想成为……；渴望成为……
words.ex: He dreams of being a pilot.
words.ex_cn: 他梦想成为一名飞行员。
words.en: To imagine or hope for something that seems unlikely or impossible to achieve.

words.ex: You should believe in oneself to do well in the test.
words.ex_cn: 你应该相信自己，才能在考试中取得好成绩。
words.en: To have confidence in one's own abilities or qualities.

words.ex: He did the homework by himself.
words.ex_cn: 他独自完成了作业。
words.en: Without help from anyone else; alone.

words.tr: phrase. 进步最快学生奖；最显著进步学生奖
words.ex: She received the Most-Improved Student Award for her outstanding progress in mathematics.
words.ex_cn: 她因在数学方面取得的显著进步而获得了进步最大学生奖。
words.en: An award given to the student who has shown the most significant improvement in their academic performance or skills over a period of time.

words.ex: He was late because of the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他因为公交车而迟到了。
words.en: You use 'because of' to introduce the reason or explanation for something.

words.tr: phrase. 熟能生巧；通过反复练习可以达到完美
words.ex: Practice makes perfect. The more you practice, the better you will become.
words.ex_cn: 熟能生巧。你练习得越多，就会变得越好。
words.en: A proverb meaning that regular and repeated performance of an activity leads to skill and excellence.
